poll.question: They have meat from the hunt. Should Wesley and Chills feast tonight—or ration carefully across the days ahead?

options.label: Feast tonight
options.desc: Food and warmth might shift Wesley's broken mood—show him they're building together

options.label: Ration carefully
options.desc: Chills' steady wisdom—Wesley learns survival is about patience, not quick wins

in_play.label: Put him to work
in_play.desc: Let salvaging the Cayenne become his redemption
